description: This file defines a Java class 'LocalDateTimeJsonConverter' which implements JSON conversion for Java's LocalDateTime objects. It provides methods to serialize and deserialize LocalDateTime instances to and from JSON string representations, using the ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME format.

classes.name: LocalDateTimeJsonConverter
classes.description: A JSON converter class for Java 8's LocalDateTime objects, implementing serialization and deserialization methods.

methods.name: convertToObject
methods.description: Converts a JSON string to a LocalDateTime object by parsing the string with ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME format.

methods.name: convertToJson
methods.description: Serializes a LocalDateTime object into its ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME string representation in JSON.

methods.name: convertedType
methods.description: Returns the class type of LocalDateTime that this converter handles.
